subject: Security discovery: Private/VPC deployment & SOC 2 / SSQ - FinHealth
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T16:15:00-04:00
Subject: Discovery recap — Private VPC & compliance (FinHealth)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have an actionable plan: 

Summary of needs:
- Private/VPC deployment with strong network isolation (no public ingress to inference nodes)
- SOC 2 Type II evidence or timeline; HIPAA/GDPR controls applicability for patient data flows
- KMS/HSM options for customer-managed keys and audit logs retention
- Potential requirement for an air-gapped on-prem option for a subset of workloads

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Private VPC deployment (customer network peering or VPC endpoints) with routing policies to limit egress
- Optional on-prem package for air-gapped inference (we ship an appliance + installer) or an in-VPC private control plane
- KMS integrations (AWS KMS / customer HSM) and configurable audit log export (SIEM-friendly format)
- SOC 2: currently undergoing Type II audit, expected completion Q3 2027. We can share our SOC 2 Type I report and interim control evidence in the meantime.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the primary compliance drivers (HIPAA, GDPR, both) and which datasets require isolation.
2) Can you share any vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) or template now? I can start populating answers this week.
3) Camila can share a deployment diagram template — please note any on-prem constraints (air-gapped, physical access, approved vendors).
4) I'll loop our security lead (Evelyn) to coordinate SSQ responses and evidence collection.

Attachments: redwood-deployment-options.pdf, vpc-arch-diagram-template.drawio (attached)

I'll follow up with an initial SSQ response by Thursday (6/24) if you share the SSQ.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Samir Patel <samir@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: FinHealth Security <security@finhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Private VPC & compliance (FinHealth)

Thanks Marcus — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Compliance scope: HIPAA is the primary requirement; GDPR applies for EU patient records only. We'll likely need isolated handling for PHI workflows.
- SOC 2: we're mostly interested in the Type II timeline and whether you can provide interim control evidence (policy docs, control owners, pen test reports). Q3 completion works as long as we can see current controls.
- On-prem / air-gapped: our security team is evaluating an air-gapped option for the most sensitive workloads. We need a clear deployment diagram and a lift/ship plan (hardware, network, maintenance windows).

I've attached our high-level vendor SSQ to give you the initial set of questions (finhealth-sample-ssq.pdf). Can your team start filling the SSQ and point us to where KMS/HSM proofs would be provided? Also want to confirm whether your private deployment supports FIPS-enabled crypto configurations.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of IT Security, FinHealth

Team: Samir attached their vendor SSQ. Can we assign owners and a timeline? Proposed owners: 
- Evelyn: own the SSQ & evidence collection (security lead)
- Camila: draft a deployment diagram (vpc + optional on-prem air-gap) using our template

Proposed timeline: initial SSQ responses (draft) by 2027-06-24; deployment diagram by 2027-06-25. Evelyn, please confirm what evidence you need from infra/product (pen test, SOC artifacts, config screenshots). Camila, use the attached vpc-arch-diagram-template.drawio and mark any assumptions.

Thanks — we should treat this as priority given HIPAA scope.

Hi all — quick status update and next steps: 

- Evelyn will lead the SSQ and is starting to pull SOC artifacts and pen test summaries. Expect list of evidence requests by EOD 6/22.
- Camila will produce a draft deployment diagram (VPC + optional on-prem/air-gap) and will call out network isolation controls and egress rules. Draft by 6/25.
- I've taken the SSQ (finhealth-sample-ssq.pdf) and started an initial pass; attaching the draft answers (ssq-initial-response.docx) for internal review. I'll push a cleaned version to Samir by 6/24.

A few open questions for FinHealth: 
1) Do you require a physically air-gapped appliance (no network connectivity) or is a private on-prem VPC with strictly controlled egress acceptable for the first phase?
2) Any preferred KMS/HSM vendors we should validate (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, etc.)?

Samir — once we confirm those two items, we can finalize our SSQ answers and the deployment diagram.
